sql: with pm as (select market_ticker, split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) as series, case when assumed_price between 93 and 95 then 'a5-7' else 'b8-10' end as band, avg(pnl/nullif(quantity,0))*100 as c from paper_trades where strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and strategy not ilike '%\_pt%' and side='no' and assumed_price between 90 and 95 and status in ('settled','closed_sl','closed_tp','closed_timeout') and created_at >= '2026-08-11' and split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXFEDMENTION','KXINX','KXINXU','KXNASDAQ100U','KXRAIN','KXTRUMPSAY','KXWCMENTION','KXTRUMPMENTION','KXAPRPOTUS','KXNASDAQ100','KXTRUMPAPPROVE') group by 1,2,3), lv as (select split_part(f.market_ticker,'-',1) as series, case when f.px >= 93 then 'a5-7' else 'b8-10' end as band, count(*) as live_mkts, sum(case when p.realized_pnl<0 then 1 else 0 end) as live_losers from (select market_ticker, max(limit_price) as px from live_orders where strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and status='filled' and side='no' and action='buy' and limit_price between 90 and 95 group by 1) f left join (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, realized_pnl from positions order by market_ticker, captured_at desc) p using (market_ticker) group by 1,2) select pm.series, pm.band, count(*) as paper_mkts, sum(case when c<0 then 1 else 0 end) as paper_losers, round(avg(c)::numeric,2) as paper_c, max(lv.live_mkts) as live_mkts, max(lv.live_losers) as live_losers from pm left join lv on lv.series=pm.series and lv.band=pm.band group by 1,2 order by 1,2
